description:
Title: Work Accident

Create a process that helps in gathering information about work accidents (and almost work accidents):
For insured gainful employment, a work accident is considered to be an accident that occurs in the following circumstances, by way of example:
* the accident occurs in a location, at a time and with a cause that correlates to the insured employment
* when working from home
* on the direct route from the permanent place of residence to work, to lunch or on the way home, whereby carpools are also protected
* for training sessions that serve to provide specific professional knowledge, whereby an accident on to way to or from the training centre is considered a work accident
* on the direct route from home, or from the workplace or training centre to a doctor and back, if this interrupts the direct route from the permanent place of residence to work or the route home (the doctor's visit must be notified to the employer in advance)
* on the way to or from the workplace or training centre with the purpose of taking a child to or collecting them from a childcare facility, a daycare facility, external care or a school, insofar as they have a supervisory responsibility for the child
* when making use of advocacy groups or professional associations (e.g. Chamber of Labour, trade union federation, guild etc.)

For kindergarten children, schoolchildren and students, an accident is considered to be a work accident if, amongst other things
* the accident occurs in a location, at a time and with a cause that correlates to the school or university education or the compulsory kindergarten year that forms the basis of the insurance
* when taking part in a school event or school-related event 
* on the direct route from the child's place of residence or permanent accommodation to kindergarten or a school visit or on the way home
* when performing a practical task prescribed as part of the curriculum and/or the study regulations or 
* in certain professional (training) orientations.

In an agricultural or forestry establishment, accidents can be considered work accidents if they do not occur directly while performing the insured employment.
Depending on the protected group of people, the following tasks are covered by accident insurance:
* working in the household of the owner of the company and/or the employee, if the household serves the company to a considerable extent
* working in connection with providing accommodation for guests 
* secondary occupations for the sale of agricultural products from the farm
* working in the context of erecting, converting and repairing buildings that serve the agricultural and forestry establishment
* working in the context of neighbourhood assistance for another agricultural and forestry establishment  

Certain accidents are considered the same as work accidents and in many cases can also affect people who do not have accident insurance.
Accidents that occur in one of the following situations, among others, are considered to be work accidents outside of professional activity:
* for activities with which services from the Unemployment Insurance Act / Labor Market Promotion Act are being made use of (e.g. on the way to an arranged job interview)
* when assisting with an accident or donating blood
* when receiving training, taking part in exercises or serving as a member of one of the following aid organisations:
    * Volunteer fire brigade
    * Volunteer water rescue service
    * Volunteer rescue organisations
    * Austrian Red Cross
    * Austrian Alpine Rescue Service
    * Austrian Water Rescue
    * Austrian Rescue Dog Brigade
    * Avalanche warning committees
    * Air rescue service
    * Radiation detection and survey crews

The employees must inform the employer immediately of:
* any work accident
* any incident that would almost have led to an accident
* any serious and immediate risk to safety and health that they discover
* any defect discovered in protection systems.

The employer must, in turn, immediately report any work accident that leads to a fatality or serious injury to the Labour Inspectorate, if it has not been reported to the emergency services.

Independent of this, every work accident in which a person with accident insurance has been killed, or injured in such a way that they are unable to work for three days, in full or in part, must be reported to the responsible accident insurance provider within five days.

As a self-employed person, please ensure that you not only report accidents involving people you employ but also those that involve you to the accident insurance provider in good time.

Students and schoolchildren should report accidents to the competent directorate.
Schools, educational facilities and universities are obliged to report every work accident through which a person with accident insurance is physically injured or killed within a maximum of five days to the responsible accident insurance provider in triplicate.

In the case of private insurance, the insured party must report an accident in writing immediately in line with the conditions and to avoid the provider from being released from the obligation to perform.
If there are fatalities, this must be reported within three days, even if the accident has already been reported.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_WorkAccident" targetNamespace="https://example.org/bpmn/work-accident">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EmployeeReport" name="Employee accident or safety report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EmployerInsuranceReport" name="Work accident report to accident insurance provider"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EmployerInspectorateReport" name="Serious or fatal work accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SelfEmployedInsuranceReport" name="Self-employed person's work accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StudentReport" name="Student or schoolchild accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SchoolInsuranceReport" name="School or education-provider accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrivateImmediateReport" name="Private insurance accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrivateFatalityReport" name="Private insurance fatality report"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employee" name="Employee accident and safety reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_EmployeeIncident" name="Accident, near accident, serious risk, or protection-system defect discovered"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherEmployeeInformation" name="Gather information about the incident">
      <bpmn:documentation>Capture the circumstances relevant to the accident and its possible coverage. Examples for insured gainful employment include an accident connected by location, time and cause to the employment; working from home; direct routes between residence, work, lunch, home, training or a doctor (where the doctor's visit was notified to the employer in advance); protected carpools; professional training; taking a supervised child to or from childcare, daycare, external care or school; and use of advocacy groups or professional associations. In agricultural or forestry establishments, potentially covered work can also include qualifying household work, guest accommodation, secondary sales of farm products, building work serving the establishment, and neighbourhood assistance. Accidents outside professional activity may also qualify in situations such as use of employment-service activities, assisting at an accident, donating blood, or specified activities with listed aid organisations. Record the applicable circumstances without assuming that coverage is established.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InformEmployer" name="Inform the employer immediately"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployeeReported" name="Employer informed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Emp_1" sourceRef="Start_EmployeeIncident" targetRef="Task_GatherEmployeeInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Emp_2" sourceRef="Task_GatherEmployeeInformation" targetRef="Task_InformEmployer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Emp_3" sourceRef="Task_InformEmployer" targetRef="End_EmployeeReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employer" name="Employer accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_EmployerReport" name="Employee report received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_EmployeeReport" messageRef="Message_EmployeeReport"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherEmployerInformation" name="Gather information about the work accident"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmployerReportingDuties" name="Determine applicable reporting duties"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportInspectorate" name="Report fatal or serious accident to the Labour Inspectorate immediately, if not reported to emergency services"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportAccidentInsurer" name="Report qualifying work accident to the accident insurance provider within five days"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployerInspectorateReported" name="Labour Inspectorate reporting completed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployerInsurerReported" name="Accident insurance provider reporting completed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployerNoExternalReport" name="No stated external reporting duty applies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_1" sourceRef="Start_EmployerReport" targetRef="Task_GatherEmployerInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_2" sourceRef="Task_GatherEmployerInformation" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerReportingDuties"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_3" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerReportingDuties" targetRef="Task_ReportInspectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">fatality or seriousInjury = true, and emergencyServicesHaveNotReported = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_4" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerReportingDuties" targetRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsurer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">insuredPersonKilled or unableToWorkForAtLeastThreeDays = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_5" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerReportingDuties" targetRef="End_EmployerNoExternalReport" name="Neither reporting condition applies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_6" sourceRef="Task_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="End_EmployerInspectorateReported"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_7" sourceRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsurer" targetRef="End_EmployerInsurerReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_SelfEmployed" name="Self-employed person's accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_SelfEmployedAccident" name="Work accident involving the self-employed person or an employed person"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherSelfEmployedInformation" name="Gather information about the work accident"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SelfEmployedReport" name="Report the accident to the accident insurance provider in good time"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SelfEmployedReported" name="Accident insurance provider informed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Self_1" sourceRef="Start_SelfEmployedAccident" targetRef="Task_GatherSelfEmployedInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Self_2" sourceRef="Task_GatherSelfEmployedInformation" targetRef="Task_SelfEmployedReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Self_3" sourceRef="Task_SelfEmployedReport" targetRef="End_SelfEmployedReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Student" name="Student or schoolchild accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_StudentAccident" name="Accident involving a student or schoolchild"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherStudentInformation" name="Gather information about the accident">
      <bpmn:documentation>Relevant circumstances can include a connection by location, time and cause to school, university or compulsory kindergarten education; a school or school-related event; the direct route between residence or permanent accommodation and kindergarten or school; a prescribed practical task; or certain professional training orientations.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_StudentReport" name="Report the accident to the competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_StudentReported" name="Competent directorate informed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Student_1" sourceRef="Start_StudentAccident" targetRef="Task_GatherStudentInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Student_2" sourceRef="Task_GatherStudentInformation" targetRef="Task_StudentReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Student_3" sourceRef="Task_StudentReport" targetRef="End_StudentReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_EducationalInstitution" name="Educational institution accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_EducationalAccident" name="Insured person physically injured or killed in a work accident"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherEducationalInformation" name="Gather information about the accident"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EducationalReport" name="Report the accident to the accident insurance provider in triplicate within five days"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EducationalReported" name="Accident insurance provider reporting completed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Edu_1" sourceRef="Start_EducationalAccident" targetRef="Task_GatherEducationalInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Edu_2" sourceRef="Task_GatherEducationalInformation" targetRef="Task_EducationalReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Edu_3" sourceRef="Task_EducationalReport" targetRef="End_EducationalReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_PrivateInsured" name="Private insurance accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_PrivateAccident" name="Private-insured accident"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherPrivateInformation" name="Gather information about the accident"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PrivateImmediateReport" name="Report the accident in writing immediately in line with the insurance conditions"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateFatality" name="Did the accident involve a fatality?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PrivateFatalityReport" name="Report the fatality within three days, even if the accident has already been reported"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PrivateReported" name="Private insurance reporting completed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_1" sourceRef="Start_PrivateAccident" targetRef="Task_GatherPrivateInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_2" sourceRef="Task_GatherPrivateInformation" targetRef="Task_PrivateImmediateReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_3" sourceRef="Task_PrivateImmediateReport" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_4" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality" targetRef="Task_PrivateFatalityReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">fatality = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_5" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality" targetRef="End_PrivateReported" name="No fatality">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">fatality = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_6" sourceRef="Task_PrivateFatalityReport" targetRef="End_PrivateReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkAccident" name="Work accident reporting">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employee" name="Employee" processRef="Process_Employee"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employer" name="Employer" processRef="Process_Employer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SelfEmployed" name="Self-employed person" processRef="Process_SelfEmployed"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Student" name="Student or schoolchild" processRef="Process_Student"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_EducationalInstitution" name="School, educational facility or university" processRef="Process_EducationalInstitution"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PrivateInsured" name="Privately insured person" processRef="Process_PrivateInsured"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_AccidentInsurer" name="Responsible accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LabourInspectorate" name="Labour Inspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Directorate" name="Competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployeeToEmployer" name="Immediate accident or safety report" sourceRef="Task_InformEmployer" targetRef="Start_EmployerReport" messageRef="Message_EmployeeReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployerToInsurer" name="Accident report" sourceRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsurer" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer" messageRef="Message_EmployerInsuranceReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployerToInspectorate" name="Fatal or serious accident report" sourceRef="Task_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="Participant_LabourInspectorate" messageRef="Message_EmployerInspectorateReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SelfEmployedToInsurer" name="Accident report" sourceRef="Task_SelfEmployedReport" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer" messageRef="Message_SelfEmployedInsuranceReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StudentToDirectorate" name="Accident report" sourceRef="Task_StudentReport" targetRef="Participant_Directorate" messageRef="Message_StudentReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EducationToInsurer" name="Report in triplicate" sourceRef="Task_EducationalReport" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer" messageRef="Message_SchoolInsuranceReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateImmediateToInsurer" name="Immediate written accident report" sourceRef="Task_PrivateImmediateReport" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer" messageRef="Message_PrivateImmediateReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateFatalityToInsurer" name="Fatality report" sourceRef="Task_PrivateFatalityReport" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer" messageRef="Message_PrivateFatalityReport"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
